export_evidence: importkey.com/countries/india/rijisha-enterprises (and slug variant /rijisha-enterprise) both return only the generic template: 'Shipments available for RIJISHA ENTERPRISES, refreshed daily' with the data block stuck at 'Loading...' — 0 shipment rows actually rendered, 0 bill-of-lading numbers, 0 dates, 0 destinations, 0 HS codes visible. Source counter: 2 importkey URLs fetched, 0 records seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on all 3 query attempts, so no domestic-supply source could be located at all.
note: No shipment evidence could be verified either way — this is an evidence gap, not a negative finding. importkey pages for both slug variants are auto-generated placeholders that exist for any queried name and contain no rows; volza, eximpedia and trademo all returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, and the web_search tool was down for the whole session (connection refused), so no second source could be checked. Declared HS 711311 (articles of jewellery of precious metal) is inconsistent with the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) — per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual one once a real shipment record is obtained. No CIN, PAN, GSTIN, revenue or export volume is public in what I could reach — all left null rather than guessed. Recommended next step: re-run with a working search backend and a paid/authenticated trade-data view (importkey trial, Volza, Export Genius) to establish whether any export or domestic supply record exists; until then the honest status is 'следов поставок не найдено / не подтверждено' rather than accepted.
